item.title: Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile servers to shut down in April 2026
item.description: Activision has confirmed that Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile will officially go offline on April 17th 2026, bringing an end to the title’s service after failing to meet expectations. Players can continue to access the game and its existing content until the shutdown date, after which the servers will no longer be available. ... [MORE]

item.title: Matthew Ball's State of Video Gaming in 2026: "China is eating the video games industry"
item.description: Despite reaching record revenues after three consecutive years of growth, private funding in the games industry fell by another 55% year-over-year in 2025. According to Epyllion CEO Matthew Ball’s State of Video Gaming in 2026 report, now available to read in Early Access, the last three months of 2025 saw less than $100 million in pre-seed investment, just over $200m in early-stage funding, and around 40 deals in total. ...
